items.text: ETR Sunday fantasy injuries: IN (Darnold, Price, Dobbins, Harvey, Nabers, Etienne, etc.); Q (Bowers, Flowers, Evans, DJ Moore, Warren, Pittman, etc.); DOUBTFUL Nacua; OUT (Daniels, Dart, Collins, Dowdle, Pierce, Brooks, Jonah Coleman, etc.).
items.why: Comprehensive Friday injury designations for main slate.
items.implication: Status clarity for DFS/season-long; multiple role changes.
items.opportunity: Warren/Schultz/Adams/Hubbard beneficiaries; Qs projected in by Levitan.

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday. Positive longer-term notes (not IR, surgery not on table) but Mariota starts this week.
items.why: Left elbow dislocation; ruled out by team/Schefter. Rapoport: good news on not IR.
items.implication: Marcus Mariota starts; Commanders lowest implied total; McLaurin target share historically holds with Mariota but tough SEA matchup.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins (hamstring) for Sunday at Indianapolis. Confirmed across official reports and insider posts.
items.why: Hamstring injury; missed practice and ruled out by team/Schefter/Rapoport/ETR.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in Houston passing game for second straight week.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for TE Dalton Schultz (28-30% target share last week sans Collins) and remaining WRs.

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe) for Sunday vs Bengals. Jaylen Warren listed questionable (shoulder) but coach says he will lead the group.
items.why: Toe injury; boot earlier in week, ruled out. Warren shoulder but projected lead.
items.implication: Clear lead back role for Warren with checkdown upside from Rodgers.
items.opportunity: Warren lead carries + high checkdown volume; Homer/Heidenreich as backups.

items.text: Puka Nacua doubtful (hip/groin), will not practice, not expected to play Sunday vs Broncos. McVay: barring setback could return next week vs Eagles. Rapoport: Adams has shown he can carry the load.
items.why: Hip/groin; no practice Friday; Schefter/McVay/Rapoport/ETR aligned on doubtful/not expected.
items.implication: Adams continues as primary WR1 with elevated route/target share.
items.opportunity: Adams 42% target rate on 142 routes without Nacua; strong recent production in Nacua absences.

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite QUESTIONABLE tags. Hoping early clarity on Flowers, AD Mitchell, DJ Moore. Big DFS implications.
items.why: ETR internal projections based on practice/injury intel.
items.implication: Treat as likely active for rankings/DFS until final inactives.
items.opportunity: Bowers season debut upside; Evans WR2; Warren lead volume.

items.text: ETR Week 3 main slate projections live. Jahmyr Gibbs set new record ceiling projection at 44.0 (avg of top 25th percentile sim outcomes).
items.why: Sim-based ceiling; highest in ETR history for the metric.
items.implication: Elite tournament/DFS upside and strong season-long start.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/carry ceiling in Lions offense.

items.text: Broncos: RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and good to go vs Rams. Jonah Coleman (ankle) ruled out.
items.why: Off report per Schefter/Broncos/ETR IN list. Coleman OUT.
items.implication: Committee returns; limits any Coleman stash upside this week.
items.opportunity: Dobbins/Harvey split work; monitor for lead.
items.conflict: Berry still long-term bullish on Coleman as the one to own later.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Steelers RB coach: Warren will lead the group. Levitan: vertical pass game failed for Rodgers; expect zillion checkdowns to Warren. Projecting Warren (Q shoulder) in. Backups: Homer + rookie Heidenreich.
items.why: Coach comment + Dowdle OUT + Rodgers checkdown tendency.
items.implication: High-floor RB2/flex with receiving upside; volume spike.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected on IR (only 5 games across 3 seasons). Pushes Chuba Hubbard firmly into lead role (RB14 utilization through 2 weeks); AJ Dillon primary backup.
items.why: Groin; IR expected per Berry Love/Hate recap and ETR OUT list.
items.implication: Hubbard locked-in RB2 with lead-back volume.
items.opportunity: Hubbard snaps/carries/red-zone as clear RB1 for CAR.

items.text: LOVE pass catchers: Dalton Schultz @IND (28% TS last week sans Collins; IND 4th-most yards to TEs); Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit targets, high aDOT, LV allows 18.7 ypr to WRs); Christian Watson vs ATL (WR8 util, 38% RZ share); Chase Brown @PIT (20+ touches, 15% TS both weeks).
items.why: Usage + matchup data in Love/Hate and 10 Facts (Schultz 30% routes targeted sans Collins).
items.opportunity: Schultz target share spike; Olave/Watson volume; Brown workhorse.

items.text: LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg. Feed him.
items.why: Elite matchup vs poor rush defense + high prop.
items.implication: Strong RB1 start with smash potential.

items.text: HATE RBs: Rhamondre Stevenson @JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RBs); Travis Etienne vs LV (only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps). HATE Terry McLaurin vs SEA (fewest FP to WRs, low ypr allowed; WAS low total).
items.why: Poor recent usage + tough matchups; 10 Facts notes Henderson snap spike but still ranks Stevenson ahead.
items.opportunity: Henderson rising but not full takeover yet per Berry.
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson over Henderson short-term despite snap data.
